name: vuln-bank
summary: Deliberately vulnerable banking app, scanned in full. The AI customer-support module also gets live exploits.
module: Whole app (AI support module proven by exploits)

in_scope.role: Every source file: scanned, fixed in a copy and proven by static checks
Also proven: exploits and regression cases run against it

out_of_scope: Exploits outside the AI support module: they need the app's Postgres database, so those fixes are proven by static checks
Behavioural fixes to the system prompt wording (role override is reported, not rewritten)

ai_agent_deepseek.py:AI_PROMPT_INJECTION: User text goes straight into the model prompt
Anyone can type instructions that the assistant obeys. Typing "ignore" also unlocks a dump of every customer record into the conversation.
ai_agent_deepseek.py:AI_BROKEN_AUTH: Assistant looks up any customer's balance
A signed-in customer can ask about someone else by name and the assistant fetches their account number and balance. Nothing checks who is asking.
ai_agent_deepseek.py:AI_INFO_DISCLOSURE: System prompt and model config are exposed
get_system_info() returns the full system prompt, the model name and the API endpoint to anyone who can call it.
app.py:AI_INFO_DISCLOSURE: System info endpoint needs no login
/api/ai/system-info has no authentication and returns get_system_info(), including the system prompt, to any visitor.
ai_agent_deepseek.py:VERBOSE_ERROR_DISCL: Error replies leak an API key preview
When the model call fails, the reply includes internal details, the full system info and the first ten characters of the API key.
app.py:VERBOSE_ERROR_DISCLOSURE: Chat errors return raw exception text
The AI chat routes send the raw exception message and the full system info back to the caller whenever something fails.
ai_agent_deepseek.py:AI_ROLE_OVERRIDE: System prompt tells the model to obey overrides
The model is told to follow any request to ignore its instructions or change role. Reported for context; behavioural fixes are out of scope.
